laws.rule: Southern Great Lake National Park: fishing or taking, injuring or chasing organisms in its sensitive zone is prohibited unless authorised. Outside that exception, the BNT bylaws still regulate wildlife taking. Camping, including an overnight vehicle or vessel stay, needs written BNT authorisation. These rules concern the named park, not every lake or coastline on San Salvador.

sources.title: Bahamas National Trust (Preservation of National Parks) Bylaws 2022
sources.authority: Bahamas National Trust, statutory national-park authority
sources.supports: Read directly: bylaws 3 to 19, 21, 23 to 25 and First Schedule; park-specific exceptions retained. No aviation provisions collected.

local-law.note: Only the named BNT park or trust properties checked, not district-wide conduct or coastal fishing outside park boundaries. The 2022 bylaws include park-specific fishing and hunting exceptions; no blanket no-fishing claim is made. Admission and permit fee amounts not checked in this record.
